title: Thawing Quintessence in Curved Background (post-DESI)
efc_relevance: Post-DESI-DR2 variant: canonical (non-phantom) quintessence remains viable in a spatially curved FRW background. Contradicts claims that DESI DR2 forces phantom dynamics. Relevant to EFC as a non-phantom alternative with different cosmographic signature; consistent with EFC background if Ω_k absorbs the L2→L3 residual.
ledger_action: Logged as 2025 non-phantom alternative. Track for Euclid-DR1-era discriminator.
